about: Real trades, nothing fails. Timed sells of what is left: 50 % at +2 s, 100 % at +60 s (the README's own kind of ladder). The buy comes back with the quote's coin count, 1,000,000; the wallet received 900,000. The +2 s sell sells half of the wallet (450,000) and the booking corrects the books to the wallet, 450,000. Then the buy's exact count arrives and the 100,000 difference is taken off a second time: books 350,000, wallet 450,000. The +60 s sell sells the 350,000 the books know and closes the position: 100,000 coins (11 % of the bag) stay in the wallet with no position. Nothing ever sells them. How a buy comes back with the quote's coin count: the real executor waits one second after the confirmation for the wallet's balance or the transaction; when neither can be read in time (a slow or rate-limited RPC, a node one block behind) the position opens with the coins the quote promised, and the exact count follows with the exact SOL up to about four seconds later (src/engine/executor.ts, BUY_READ_MS; engine.ts buy(): 'The buy was handed back with the quote's coin count ... corrected').
